  2  value:Expectation:1
     in: (1)

  3  Aggregation
     in: (2)                            out: 𝑉
     ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
     rule: 𝑉(k) = E_{Ψ, θ}[𝑉≻(𝑔≻(k, 𝜍(k), Ψ, θ))]

  4  Evaluation
     in: 𝑉                              out: 𝑉
     ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
     rule: 𝑉 : ℝ₊ → ℝ
           D_{k}𝑉(k)
             = E_{Ψ, θ}[(f
                          ↦ (c, y)
                            ↦ sup_{a ∈
                              {a ∈ ℝ |
                               ∀ epsilon ∈ (0, ∞): (∃ delta ∈ (0, ∞): (∀ t ∈
                               {t ∈ ℝ |
                               (t²)^(1/2) > 0
                               ∧ (t²)^(1/2) < delta
                               ∧ c + t ∈ ℝ₊₊}: ((((f(c + t, y) − f(c, y))/t
                               − a)²)^(1/2)
                               < epsilon)))}} [a])((w, unit)
                               ↦ 𝑉≻(𝑔≻(k, 𝜍(k), Ψ, θ)))(w≻, ()) · (𝜍(k) · Ψ
                            + (1 − 𝜍(k)) · R)]

  Aggregation  𝑉(k) ∈ ℝ
